sprites.name: loose
sprites.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated terrain obstacle sprite for a cozy Father Frost merge game, matching bright rounded painted 2.5D casual game objects. Genuine transparent background. No text, numbers, icons, gifts, tools, borders or decorative background. A roughly square snow-covered patch that fits one square cell, viewed mostly from above with only a modest visible front thickness, no isometric diamond. Large clean readable silhouette with gently rounded corners, occupies 85% of a square canvas, centered with padding. Soft upper-left light, snowy cream-white highlights with clean sky-blue shaded edges; clearly readable at 48 pixels. Do not include floating glows around it or heavy ground shadows. Subject: LOOSE FRESH SNOW: a shallow soft fluffy mound, low rounded cloudlike lobes, powdery white top, only a little pale blue shading. Very soft, airy, inviting. No hard edges, no crystals, no deep cracks. A low smooth 3-lobed silhouette.
